marketEntry.summary: We help you prepare and carry out your entry into the Czech and other European markets, and design an efficient operating model without the need to build your own local team.
intro: Entering a new market brings a number of organisational, administrative and commercial challenges. Getting to know the local environment, finding suitable suppliers and setting up operational processes correctly can take considerable time and staff capacity.

Silverdahl helps international companies prepare and carry out their entry into the Czech and other European markets. Our goal is to design an efficient way of operating locally without the need to build your own operations team.

Based on the client’s specific requirements, Silverdahl identifies and approaches suitable service providers, organises tenders and coordinates the start of the cooperation.
We are not limited to areas in which we already have experience. Depending on the nature of the project, we can map the market and find suitable specialised providers in other fields as well.

seo.title: Case study Courlux: 30+ years in four CEE markets
seo.description: How Silverdahl has sourced suppliers, coordinated call centres and run operations for the Swiss company Courlux in four Central European markets for 30+ years.

intro.subtitle: More than 30 years of comprehensive operational support in four European markets
intro.text: The Swiss trading company Courlux International SA relies on Silverdahl as its long-term partner for business and operational activities in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland and Hungary.

task.heading: Our task
task.statement: Our task is to find suitable local suppliers, set up the cooperation and then manage the entrusted processes so that their day-to-day coordination does not burden the Swiss headquarters.

story.title: From the first business partners to comprehensive operations management
story.p1: The cooperation began with customer service, the localisation of marketing materials and the search for partners to acquire new customers. Initially these were mainly newspaper and magazine publishers through which Courlux ran its marketing campaigns.
story.p2: As the market evolved, we gradually found and contracted external call centres. For each country we organised the supplier selection, compared offers, negotiated commercial terms and then took over the coordination of their work and the evaluation of results.
story.highlightLabel: Period of the largest scope of cooperation
story.highlight: During the most intensive campaigns we coordinated up to four call centres in a single market, with total customer acquisition exceeding 30,000 new customers per month.
story.p3: Over time, we secured other specialised partners in a similar way – for example for IT support, customs declarations, postal and logistics services and legal advice.

today.title: How the cooperation works today
today.p1: Today Silverdahl independently coordinates most of Courlux’s local business and operational processes in all four markets.
today.p2: We manage the cooperation with external suppliers, continuously monitor their quality and costs, resolve operational issues and respond to changes in business requirements and legislation. One example is the successful implementation of GDPR-related processes.
today.p3: Our responsibilities also include preparing business budgets and evaluating them regularly. We provide the Swiss headquarters with daily, weekly and monthly reporting, including a comparison of actual results against the plan.
today.p4: Within approved budgets and delegated powers, we handle operational matters independently. The headquarters retains strategic and financial decisions, inventory management and the distribution of goods from Switzerland.

kouril.focus: Strategy, business development, international partnerships and company management.
bio: Tomáš has led Silverdahl since it was founded in 1994 and shapes its strategic direction, the development of business relationships and the management of long-term cooperation with international partners.
His role focuses mainly on business negotiations, developing the partner network, setting the terms of cooperation and overseeing the company’s financial, personnel and operational performance.
Drawing on his experience of the international business environment and service outsourcing, he helps build long-term, stable business relationships.

tauchman.focus: Project management, supplier coordination, operational reporting and process optimisation.
bio: Michal has many years of experience in project management, coordinating business partners and providing operational support for international business activities.

He has worked at Silverdahl since 2008. During his career he has been involved in managing business and marketing projects, coordinating external suppliers and running operational processes for international business partners.

He specialises in organising and managing projects, coordinating cooperation between headquarters abroad and local suppliers, and operational controlling. His focus is on preparing and managing budgets, regular reporting, evaluating business results and monitoring the cost-effectiveness of individual activities.

He holds a bachelor’s degree in Marketing Communication and a master’s degree in Economics and Management, which he completed with honours. In his work he combines economic and management expertise with marketing know-how.

faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about entering the Czech and Central European market, selecting suppliers and managing local operations.
faq.title: Questions about entering the Czech market

items.q: Do I need my own branch and employees to enter the Czech market?
items.a: Not necessarily. Many activities – customer service, logistics, accounting or marketing – can be provided by specialist suppliers. Silverdahl finds them, sets up the cooperation and coordinates it long term, so you do not need to build your own local team.

items.q: Which markets can you help with?
items.a: We have long-standing experience in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland and Hungary. Depending on the project, we can also help in other European markets.

items.q: What kind of suppliers can you arrange?
items.a: For example contact centres, marketing and advertising services, printing and distribution, logistics, warehousing and fulfilment, IT, accounting and tax services, legal advice, customs services, translation and localisation, or HR services. The list is not closed.

items.q: How long does it take to prepare a market entry?
items.a: It depends on the scope of the project and the number of suppliers needed. After the initial analysis we prepare a concrete timeline so you know exactly when operations can start.

items.q: Do I have to use all of your services?
items.a: No. We can handle a one-off supplier selection, the complete preparation of a market entry or the long-term management of operations – whatever you need right now.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: We communicate in Czech, English and German. Reporting is prepared in the language and format that suits your headquarters.

items.q: How will I keep track of operations and costs?
items.a: We provide regular reporting – daily, weekly or monthly as agreed – including supplier performance, costs and a comparison of actual results with the plan.

seo.description: How Silverdahl s.r.o. processes personal data from the contact form and the website, how long we keep it and what your rights are under the GDPR.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We value your privacy. This page explains what personal data we process when you use the website, why and for how long, and what your rights are.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: The controller of your personal data is:

data.title: What data we process
items: Contact form data: first and last name, company name (optional), e-mail, subject and message.
Data from e-mail and phone communication if you contact us directly.
Technical data: IP address and browser information in server logs.
Cookie data according to your choice – see the cookie policy for details.

purposes.title: Why we process data and on what legal basis
items: Handling your enquiry and discussing cooperation – steps prior to entering into a contract and our legitimate interest in answering your message (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).
Ensuring the secure and reliable operation of the website – our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Displaying the Google map and any analytics or marketing tools – only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

retention.title: How long we keep data
paragraphs: We keep contact form messages and related communication for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry, at most 3 years from the last communication unless a contractual relationship arises. Server logs are deleted after 90 days at the latest.

recipients.title: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing purposes. Only our processors who provide technical services for us may have access to it:
items: our e-mail service provider, which delivers messages from the contact form,
Google Ireland Ltd. – only if you allow the map in the cookie settings.

transfers.title: Transfers outside the EU
paragraphs: We process data within the European Union. An exception may be Google when the map is displayed – any transfer to the USA is based on the European Commission's adequacy decision on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

rights.title: Your rights
paragraphs: In connection with the processing of your personal data, you have the right:
items: to access your data and obtain a copy,
to erasure if the data is no longer needed or you have withdrawn your consent,
to object to processing based on legitimate interest,
to withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it,
to lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, www.uoou.cz) or with the supervisory authority in your country.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: The website is available exclusively over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Only authorised persons bound by confidentiality have access to the data.
